tldr: The Gaussian model has a terminating sharp-constant characterization and the proved \(N^{-1/2}\) design limit. Its canonical bracket remains \(1923/20000<C(1/10,(1/2,1/2))\le2123/20000\), with the unchanged half-share upper policy. The corrected additive tail argument proves proper least-favorable-prior existence at positive excess; finite least-favorable priors never suffice. The complete canonical optimizer set remains unresolved, as does the all-parameter evaluated frontier.
